I've written a Lean proof of the sealed statement `P2.CarbonContinuity`. The local `viridis-lean-check` passes all five stages, and the proof uses only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. That check is a preview: the PROVEN label comes from the verifier after the session.

**The proof** (`out/proofs/P2.CarbonContinuity.lean`) is a short port of the archived canon proof to the sealed definitions:
- **Sufficiency:** the portfolio (L, D) = (r, 1 − a) is a positive witness. It holds the living pool exactly, and the durable pool does not shrink when (1 − a)(1 − d) ≤ rp.
- **Necessity:** rearranging the two inequalities gives (1 − a)L ≤ rD and (1 − d)D ≤ pL. Multiplying them and cancelling LD > 0 gives the threshold.
- **Unused assumptions:** the proof never uses 0 ≤ a, 0 ≤ d or p > 0. I recorded this in `run.json` as a separate unsealed observation (C2), not as part of the formal claim.

**The paper** (`out/paper/main.tex`) compiles with `latexmk -pdf`. It states the model and the threshold, gives the proof with a Lean listing, and has a section on what the theorem settles and what it does not:
- **Settles:** the threshold logic the kernel applies.
- **Does not settle:**
  - any coefficient value;
  - whether the linear model fits real forests;
  - what happens over many cycles;
  - whether the TypeScript implementation matches the rule.

It cites the canon record (10.5281/zenodo.21855690) and Berman & Plemmons for the Perron–Frobenius background; I checked that both DOIs resolve.

**Other outputs:** `out/notes.md`, `out/run.json` (one formal claim plus the observation) and a 370-character `out/announcement.md`. I removed the LaTeX build artifacts so `out/` holds only files the contract allows. I didn't use Aristotle, so there are no project IDs. There were no prior runs, so nothing was pending.

**Not covered:** the canon's extra results (exact balance at the threshold, strict growth above it, a worked numeric example) aren't part of the sealed statement, so I didn't port them.

Sources:
- [Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.21855690](https://zenodo.org/doi/10.5281/zenodo.21855690)
- [Berman & Plemmons, Nonnegative Matrices in the Mathematical Sciences (SIAM)](https://epubs.siam.org/doi/book/10.1137/1.9781611971262)
- [Semantic Scholar entry for Berman & Plemmons](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/Nonnegative-Matrices-in-the-Mathematical-Sciences-Berman-Plemmons/099e9af1b8f874457dea9526516ce8c8dcb93662)
